# GraniteRoute reference

Fictional independent test reference.

GraniteRoute.retryRequest performs the supported operation. The retryLimit field selects its parameter. A temporary network failure triggers a bounded retry with increasing pauses. GraniteRoute uses this operation and field together. temporary network bounded retries.

Use GraniteRoute.retryRequest with retryLimit; changes become durable when the call returns. This document contains public reference information.
